title: TC-RG-01/TC-RG-02 fail on main: T010 baseline has 75 BLOCKERs (117 total) but GH-512 snapshot v4 still expects 74 / 116 -- snapshot stale after WF02-idn05-20260812 commit 34d7ca13
registered_by: ISSUE-FIXER (WF03-GH759-20260813 Step 0.5, third recurrence of test-baseline-drift class)
scope: tools/lint_test_isolation.baseline.json (committed baseline); tests/specs/fixtures/gh512-baseline-snapshot.json (snapshot fixture); tests/integration/gh512_t010_regression_test.zig (TC-RG-01/02). No production code path affected.
symptom: tests/integration/gh512_t010_regression_test.zig TC-RG-01 (live ceiling) and TC-RG-02 (snapshot-vs-baseline) fail on main because the committed baseline (75 T010 BLOCKER, 117 total) no longer matches the snapshot fixture (74 T010 BLOCKER, 116 total, platform_admin_uuid_count=14) or the test's `t010_blocker_ceiling` constant (= 74). The drift was introduced by commit 34d7ca13 (WF02-idn05-20260812, GH-746 -- 'Named role registry and ROLE assignee resolution') which added tests/integration/idn05_role_registry_test.zig whose local adminActor() helper at line 70 reintroduces the canonical platform-admin UUID literal (RETAIN class), correctly bumping the baseline 74->75 / 116->117 -- but never updated the snapshot fixture or test ceiling constant in the same commit. The same drift was discovered and fixed inline (Unblock-Everything) as commit 0fff689f on feature/WF03-GH752-20260812 (filed as its own issue GH-757) but that fix was NOT merged to main when GH-752 was squash-merged (commit 9d06bdf4), so main remains stale. This is the THIRD recurrence of this drift class (predecessors: ISS-0648/GH-653, ISS-0664/GH-701).

root_cause_analysis.drift_introducing_commit_summary: feat: Named role registry and ROLE assignee resolution; added tests/integration/idn05_role_registry_test.zig with platform-admin UUID RETAIN at line 70 (adminActor() helper); correctly regenerated tools/lint_test_isolation.baseline.json but did not update the snapshot fixture or test ceiling constant.
root_cause_analysis.predecessor_fix_unmerged_reason: Squash-merge of GH-752 (commit 9d06bdf4) did not include 0fff689f because 0fff689f was on the same feature branch but committed after the PR was already approved and queued for squash-merge.
root_cause_analysis.details: Third recurrence of the test-baseline-drift class (predecessors: ISS-0648/GH-653 in WF02-batch-0-20260811, ISS-0664/GH-701 in WF03-GH681-20260810). Each time a new test file is added that produces a T010 finding correctly-suppressed by tools/lint_test_isolation.baseline.json, the baseline's total_issues grows by the corresponding entry count but tests/specs/fixtures/gh512-baseline-snapshot.json's total_issues expectation is not updated in lockstep. The on-disk baseline.json is itself internally consistent (117 total, T010=75, T020=11, T030=6, T050=23, T060=2 matches live scan exactly). The drift is purely in the test fixture + ceiling constant + snapshot_v*_addendum documentation lag.
